text:
maya: Quick update — PR #23100 (db: migrate-nullable) is green locally and passes unit tests but the macOS / integration job is stuck in the CI queue (job 7/12). I want to avoid landing during the Friday deploy freeze window.
kevin: thanks for flagging. what's the ETA on the stuck job?
maya: CI shows it pending for ~45m, message says 'queued: insufficient mac runners'. ci-bot, any ideas? :eyes: 
ci-bot: job 7/12 for PR #23100 is queued due to runner capacity; estimated start ~30m. Priority: normal.
alex: if it's >30m we should consider splitting the rollout: canary on dedicated infra then full. That avoids touching the freeze.
sarah: +1 to canary. also we could rebase to latest main to pick up a flaky-fix from PR #23080 — low risk.
maya: rebase is small. I can do it, but that'll retrigger the whole matrix and probably extend queue time.
kevin: option tradeoffs: (1) wait for current job -> land before freeze if it starts soon; (2) rebase + rerun -> extra queue time; (3) staggered landing: land a canary behind feature flag on dedicated capacity now, then full after maintenance window. Ops-bot, can we reserve a canary slot?
ops-bot: reserved dedicated canary slot: gpu-pool-dedicated-1 for 1 hour starting now.
sarah: nice. maya can you push a canary-only config (feature flag on, traffic 1%) and we promote after smoke pass?
maya: yes. I'll create a canary PR variant and request a quick e2e run:```bash
# smoke run
curl -X POST $CI_RETRY_ENDPOINT -d '{"pr":23100, "matrix":"smoke"}'
```
maya: pinging @kevin for quick approval on canary conf.
kevin: giving eyes now, assuming smoke is green merge canary patch. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: smoke matrix triggered for PR #23100 (job set: smoke). Estimated runtime 8m.
alex: once smoke passes, let's monitor token-level latency in console for 10m. If nothing weird, we merge canary only.
sarah: remind infra to disable auto-scale down on that pool until we finish verification. ops-bot?
ops-bot: autoscale hold applied to gpu-pool-dedicated-1 for 45 minutes.
maya: smoke passed. logs look clean. merging canary now.
ci-bot: merge request for canary branch merged into staging. Full matrix will still be pending for main merge.
kevin: good call. we'll avoid the freeze by only landing canary. For full rollout let's re-evaluate tomorrow morning when the CI queue is less busy.
sarah: created a calendar event for re-eval @ 09:30 PT and added checklist: rebase-if-needed, run full matrix, run canary-promote job.
maya: thanks all. I'll follow up in the morning with the rebase outcome.
kevin: ack. great coordination. :rocket:
